_about: Territorial dataset registry (seeded into territorial_datasets by prisma/seed-territorial-datasets.mjs). It records which territorial sources EXIST, what they measure, and whether Vigil may reuse them. Only an entry with a geometryFile is imported, and only as UNPUBLISHED drafts: a human approves it in /admin/territorial-control before anything reaches the public map. Entries without a geometryFile are source candidates (reviewStatus candidate) or blocked sources; they appear in the admin coverage view only. researchedAt: 2026-09-25.

datasets.name: Yemen — Areas of control (ACAPS)
datasets.attribution: Areas of control: ACAPS Yemen Analysis Hub, via HDX (CC BY 4.0). Dissolved per actor and simplified by Vigil.
datasets.coverageDescription: District-level (Admin 2) classification of de facto control: DFA (Ansar Allah / Houthis) vs IRG. A whole district is assigned to one side; no frontlines or positions.
datasets.notes: Imported with scripts/import-acaps-yemen.mjs. Only snapshots in the current single-file schema (field areas_of_c) are imported; the provider publishes dated snapshots roughly quarterly, so the timeline shows exactly the snapshot dates and nothing before the first one.

datasets.name: Yemen — ACAPS per-actor snapshots 2021–2024 (STC control, AQAP presence)
datasets.coverageDescription: Older snapshots (2021-02 to 2024-10) ship separate shapefiles per actor: DFA, IRG, STC (control) and 'AQAP Presence' (presence, not control).
datasets.notes: Reusable (CC BY) but a different actor taxonomy from the current schema: merging STC into IRG, or AQAP presence into control, would invent changes. Import as its own versioned dataset, and the AQAP layer as a separate PRESENCE dataset, never as control.

datasets.name: Ukraine — Assessed control of terrain (ISW / CTP)
datasets.provider: Institute for the Study of War / AEI Critical Threats
datasets.license: Proprietary: the geodata is ISW's exclusive intellectual property; use requires ISW's written consent.
datasets.coverageDescription: Daily polygons of assessed Russian control, claimed advances and counteroffensives.
datasets.notes: Not imported. Request written permission from ISW before any use; do not pull the ArcGIS feature services.

datasets.name: Ukraine — Occupied territory (DeepStateMap)
datasets.license: Proprietary licence agreement: API use by approval only; redistribution, publication or proxying prohibited.
datasets.coverageDescription: Daily MultiPolygon of Russian-occupied territory; community GitHub mirrors exist but do not grant reuse rights.
datasets.notes: Not imported. An API licence can be requested at https://api.deepstatemap.live/request.

datasets.name: Myanmar — Areas of control (British Red Cross, HDX)
datasets.provider: British Red Cross Maps Team (via HDX)
datasets.license: Listed as CC0, but the layer is a georeferenced copy of a Wikipedia map image (CC BY-SA); single snapshot 2025-03-08.
datasets.notes: Not imported: turning the raster into polygons would be tracing an image, and its licence is inconsistent with its Wikipedia origin.

datasets.name: Myanmar — Settlement control markers (Wikipedia module)
datasets.provider: Wikipedia contributors (Module:Myanmar Civil War detailed map)
datasets.coverageDescription: Point markers per settlement with a controlling side and sources; no area polygons.
datasets.notes: Points, not areas: would need a point layer (settlement control) rather than polygons; share-alike terms apply to derived data.

datasets.name: Syria — Settlement control markers (Wikipedia module)
datasets.provider: Wikipedia contributors (Module:Syrian Civil War detailed map)
datasets.coverageDescription: Point markers per settlement; control changed fundamentally after December 2024.
datasets.notes: Same constraints as the Myanmar module; verify currency before any use.

datasets.name: Mexico — Cartel activity by municipality (Coscia & Rios 2012)
datasets.coverageDescription: Web-content mentions of drug-trafficking organisations per municipality and year, 1990s to 2010.
datasets.notes: Measures reported ACTIVITY (mentions), which at most supports PRESENCE, never control. Outdated and no reuse licence: ask the authors first.

datasets.name: Mexico — Criminal group presence (OCVED)
datasets.license: Not stated on the public site.
datasets.coverageDescription: Municipality-level presence of criminal organisations derived from media and government sources.
datasets.notes: PRESENCE / INFLUENCE only, never control. Licence must be obtained before use.
